messages:
maria (PM): quick sync — we need to frame the long-term platform trajectory for routing + multi-region + tenant isolation. goal: a small set of clear lanes teams can choose (and sales can sell). what are the minimal launch criteria and top customer asks we should bake in?
raj (Eng-Arch): +1. propose we define 3 lanes: 1) latency-first (edge affinity), 2) balanced (regional failover), 3) cost-optimized (batched / quantized). each lane should have explicit SLOs, fallback policy, and billing signal.
nash (ash_dev): infra note — lane 1 needs sticky KV-caching and shorter batching windows; lane 3 needs richer batching and permissive quantization profiles. both have different autoscale footprints.
sophie (Sales): from customers: two asks keep coming: a) deterministic p95 for SLAs, b) clear residency options for regulated customers. AcmeHealth asked for per-tenant region pin + audit logs. they want a launchable contract language.
maria (PM): good. let's capture launch criteria as: measurable SLOs, migration path for existing tenants, a rollback + canary policy, cost delta estimate, and docs for Sales/Legal. rough targets?
raj (Eng-Arch): draft targets: latency lane p95 <= 120ms (in-region), balanced p95 <= 220ms, cost lane best-effort but 30-50% lower token cost vs balanced. availability target >= 99.95% for GA lanes. fallback policy: automatic reroute to balanced if region capacity exhausted; explicit opt-in for tenant evacuation.
nash (ash_dev): realistic infra constraints: p95 120ms assumes NVLink-enabled nodes + edge GPU pool; that's a reserved capacity ask. if Sales needs predictable pricing, we should model a reserved SKU.
sophie (Sales): we can sell reserved SKU but need a clear rollout story: pilot customers get a 90-day SLA trial and migration support. include explicit cutover playbook in docs.
maria (PM): what are hard vs soft requirements for GA? I want a crisp acceptance checklist we can run in the launch sprint.
raj (Eng-Arch): hard: SLO verification (p95 + availability), cross-region failover test, tenant data residency enforcement, per-tenant billing correctness. soft: perf optimization for tails, cost model refinements, auto-quantization tuning.
nash (ash_dev): test harness items: synthetic traffic generator for multi-region, tenant-isolation fuzz tests (simulate noisy neighbors), and end-to-end billing validation. estimate 3 sprints to get infra + tests stable if we carve dedicated effort.
sophie (Sales): dependencies: legal needs a standard residency addendum, finance needs per-tenant chargeback modeling. both will slow us if we don't loop them early.
maria (PM): proposed prioritization: 1) core SLOs + routing policies (w/ canary), 2) tenant residency enforcement + audit logs, 3) reserved SKU + pricing model, 4) cost-optimization lane tuning. agree?
raj (Eng-Arch): agree. also call out an escape hatch: when capacity constrained, we should offer a configurable routing policy per-tenant, e.g., prefer-local, prefer-cost, or force-residency. that reduces surprise.
nash (ash_dev): implementation note: policy knobs should be in the Console + API. simple DSL: {"affinity": "local|regional|cost", "fallback": "balanced|force-fail"} — we can iterate later.
sophie (Sales): please make sure Console shows estimated $/month delta for each lane in the quote flow. customers ask for that upfront.
maria (PM): action items: raj -> write architecture spec with lane definitions + acceptance tests (due EOW). ash -> list infra work + rough ETA (due Tue). sophie -> collect 3 anchor customers for pilot and legal contacts. I'll draft the launch checklist.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: #platform-roadmap-review Thu 10:30.
raj (Eng-Arch): one more thing — migration path: must support incremental tenant cutover with traffic mirroring + shadow runs for 2 weeks before DNS cutover. include rollback steps and cost perf comparisons.
maria (PM): yes. add migration metrics: error budget burn during cutover, latency delta, and cost delta. we'll gate GA on stable cutover for at least two pilots.
sophie (Sales): noted. i'll push timeline to pilot customers after we get the spec. :thumbsup:
nash (ash_dev): ack. will prototype small-batch path and share numbers in next sync.
maria (PM): thanks team. I'll pull these into the roadmap doc and tag folks for review.
